Rewrite the intro paragraph of ## Screenshots to describe the current multi-page IA and the accurate native-first story: native MATRIX is the coin of the Go consensus L1 (single source of truth for balances, capped at 1,000,000,000 whole MATRIX at 9 decimals); wMATRIX is the bridged ERC-20 mirror for exchange listing (NOT 'the ERC-20 settlement token'); fast leader-based BFT consensus; local + provider-API LLM inference; the matrix CLI; and the Console desktop app.

Correct the MATRIX caption so it no longer calls it an ERC-20 settlement token.
Keep the 'Console (apps/console)' subsection with console-app.png and an accurate caption (providers, jobs, native MATRIX wallet, consensus, inference tabs).

Also fix the 'contracts' bullet in the '## Monorepo layout' section if it inaccurately calls MATRIX 'the ERC-20 settlement and earning token' — reframe to the wrapped/bridged ERC-20 mirror of the native coin, staying accurate.
Verify every ![...](docs/screenshots/<file>.png) path corresponds to an existing file via ls.
